text:
Maya: FYI — LumenPath needs final assets for their marketplace listing. Dropping the current bundle here. Need design + legal + CS signoff. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/lumenpath-assets ; S3: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-assets/lumenpath-v1.zip @Ada (Design) @LegalBot :eyes:

Jonah: On it. Quick checklist?

Maya: Checklist:
```
- logos: lumenpath_logo_color.svg, lumenpath_logo_white.svg, lumenpath_logo_icon.svg
- hero images: hero-1600x900.png, hero-800x450.png
- marketplace tiles: tile-1200x628.png, tile-600x314.png
- case study: lumenpath-case-study.pdf
- customer quote: skyline-quote.txt ("Redwood reduced inference costs by 42%...")
- co-sell badge png + vector
- alt text + accessibility copy
```

Ada (Design): The white logo needs +16px clearspace on all sides — current export is tight. Also the icon SVG has an extra group transform causing weird rasterization in the tile. I'll upload fixed files to the same S3 path by EOD. :white_check_mark:

LegalBot: The quote references Skyline Retail. We need a signed release or a written approval from their comms/contact. Can you attach the signed permission? If not, change the quote to an anonymized version or remove org name. Uploaded `skyline_quote_release_signed.pdf`? Not yet. :warning:

Eli (CS): I can ping our Skyline contact (Marisol) today. Marisol ok'd the case study draft in Jan but I don't recall a signed quote. I'll follow up and share timestamped approval.

Priya (Partnerships): Also confirm co-brand lockup rules — LumenPath's brand guide wants equal clearspace and prohibits white-on-white overlays. Can design confirm marketplace tile is compliant on both dark/light backgrounds?

Ada (Design): Confirmed — I'll produce two variants (dark and light) and include 3x density PNGs. Will add alt text per our Accessibility guide.

Maya: Perfect. Legal, once we have the signed release, can you run the short-form quote (max 30 words) through review? We prefer the condensed line for the marketplace tile.

LegalBot: Yes — please attach the proposed short-form text in this thread.

Jonah: Proposed short-form: "Redwood inference cut our per-query cost by 42% while improving p95 latency". Thoughts?

Maya: Maybe remove exact percent until legal confirms. Alternative: "Significant cost reductions and latency improvements".

Priya: LumenPath marketing also requested a co-selling blurb: 2-3 sentences about joint solution and a CTA to 'Learn more' which should link to our joint solution brief URL. I'll draft it once assets are greenlit.

Maya: Ok scheduling a 20m sync 2pm PT today to close any open items. Will post calendar invite. Thanks everyone. :calendar:

Ada (Design): Uploaded updated assets to S3: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-assets/lumenpath-v1.1.zip — please review.

LegalBot: Uploaded redlined quote to Drive: https://drive.google.com/.../redlined_skyline_quote. I'll take final once approval arrives. :mag_right:

Eli (CS): Pinged Marisol — she replied "I'll get legal to sign it by EOD". :thumbsup:

Maya: Awesome. If approval hits, Priya can publish the marketplace listing Monday. :rocket:
